hooks.command: GATE_WORKTREE="$WORKTREE_PATH"; echo "HOOK: WorktreeRemove — path=${GATE_WORKTREE:-unset} at $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log; broker_pid=$(ps -eo pid=,command= | grep 'app-server-broker.mjs' | grep -- "--cwd $GATE_WORKTREE" | awk '{print $1}'); [ -n "$broker_pid" ] && kill "$broker_pid" 2>/dev/null; db_mk=$(find "$GATE_WORKTREE" -maxdepth 3 -name Makefile -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec grep -l '^db-down:' {} + 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$db_mk" ]; then make -C "$(dirname "$db_mk")" db-down 2>&1 || echo "WARN: db-down failed for $db_mk"; else echo "WARN: no db-down target found under $GATE_WORKTREE"; fi

payload=$(cat); agent_type=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"agent_type":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); agent_id=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"agent_id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); session_id=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"session_id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "HOOK: SubagentStop — type=${agent_type:-unknown} id=${agent_id:-unknown} session=${session_id:-unknown} payload_size=${#payload} exited" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log
